data: Is the root note in the Decision Tree labeled x_1<a_2?

The caption states that the Decision Tree model is used to evaluate the credibility of each node in the tree comment network for discovering evidence. The figure shows a tree comment network on the left and a decision tree on the right. The decision tree has nodes labeled with inequalities. The root node of the decision tree is labeled with the inequality \(x_1 < a_2\). Therefore, the answer is yes.
